basis: Early Access Terms v1.0 (effective 2026-09-05), privacy policy, sub-processor register and Organization data on holos33.com. Where pages disagree, these documents win.
what_it_is: Holos33 is a privacy-first wellbeing platform built in the EU. It combines an AI coach, optional biofeedback from wearables, a daily check-in with a wellbeing score, and six evidence-informed modules: stress, sleep, breathing, hypnosis, nutrition and movement.

status.summary: Holos33 has not launched commercially yet. People join a waitlist and are admitted in small groups to free Early Access. No public launch date has been announced.

audiences.summary: Adults (18+) in the EU/EEA who want support with stress, sleep, energy and habits. Join the free Early Access waitlist.
Coaches, therapists, lifestyle coaches, yoga and mindfulness teachers and similar professionals can register partner interest. A professional dashboard and a white-label option are in development.

Organisations can request a 30-minute demo. Options are a 6-week pilot, a quarterly programme or an annual licence, with anonymous group reports for at least 10 participants. Prices are given on request.
Research partners can collaborate on digital wellbeing studies with privacy safeguards.

not_for: Diagnosis or treatment of medical or psychological conditions. Holos33 is not a medical device and does not replace a doctor, psychologist or therapist.
Acute crisis. Call 112 in the EU, or 113 Suicide Prevention in the Netherlands on 0800-0113.

access.valid_through_note: Early Access runs until 2027-03-31 at the latest and may be extended. Ending earlier requires at least 30 days' notice.
fair_use: All 6 modules, daily check-in, wellbeing score and knowledge base: unlimited.
Wearable sync: once per day, up to 90 days of history.
Voice and transcription (once available): 60 minutes per month.
Data export and account deletion: always, free.
access.paid_plans: Paid personal plans (phase 2) have not been priced yet. Nobody is moved onto a paid plan automatically.
access.founding_member_benefit: Everyone with an active Early Access account at the end date gets 40% off the personal plan for 12 months. The first 250 who complete both feedback rounds get a free Core account for at least 24 months.

wearables.note: This list comes from the Early Access Terms. Some other pages mention more integrations; treat those as planned until the terms list them.

privacy.summary: Data is stored on servers inside the EU, never sold and never used for advertising. Health-related data is processed only with explicit consent (GDPR Art. 9(2)(a)). Employers never see individual data.

disclaimer: Holos33 supports wellbeing and relaxation. It is not a medical device, does not diagnose, and does not replace a doctor, psychologist or therapist.
